Find Python Location from Environment Setting

Source: R/21e-DEGAS_Screen.R
FindPy.Rd

Locate the Python executable path from a predefined environment configuration list; if no suitable environment exists, create a new Python environment and return its path.

Usage

FindPy(env_params, method_name = "DEGAS", verbose = TRUE, ...)
